relationships

search

For a named type/function, prefer symbols first, scoped references for textual uses, then bounded read_file; search supplements that investigation. Explicit vector/hybrid and saved RequireComplete refuse helper outages. Vector/hybrid need the indexed local model. semantic=true aliases vector. status
  Quick version, health and project-index check: counts, publication, source-update state, semantic readiness and configured query_concurrency at frontend admission. Obtain before broad evidence fan-out; lightweight does not mean exempt from bounded admission. Completed same-authority observations superseded by scalar invalidation return successfully with status_observation.superseded and their original publication/time. Successful snapshots may be cached for five seconds; observed_unix_ms, cache_age_ms and cached disclose their age. Allows up to ten seconds for shared cold runtime setup, followed by a two-second observation budget; expiry reports unknown readiness and null evidence. Always skips process diagnostics and editor probes. Call diagnostics for detailed work, runtime versions and Explorer attachment. Counts are saved evidence, not proof that live files match. suggest_view
